profile.headline: Staff SDET at Grail
profile.summary: I am a design and process driven engineer who aims to develop a product with the highest quality by providing excellent debuggability, code sanity/hygiene, and thorough documentation.   As I’ve gone through diverse spaces in networking and cyber security, I’ve constantly evolved my learning process and can become proficient in new technologies very quickly.  With my vast experiences in Software, QA, and Automation, I am an excellent asset to any company looking for a creative, quality driven engineer. I am seeking l position in development or QA/Automation for a challenging project where I can continue to apply and grow my skills.
